reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate and getBudgetData query, but leaves setZero and the three average actions each issuing their own category query instead of sharing one selection.

duplication.why: The same categories/category_groups join is now written four times (setZero plus three identical average queries, each with the same inline type intersection) rather than factored once.

placement.why: The rule stays in the budget actions module's shared predicate and the data comes from the same module's queries, consistent with the tree's layering.

scope.why: Core change is focused, but the test edit renames unrelated variables in the copyUntilYearEnd setup (hiddenCategory/hiddenGroup bound to non-hidden rows and never used).

maintainability.why: The predicate depends on each site's query supplying group_hidden and goal_def; the average queries select only c.* and drop their g.hidden filter, so the hidden-group part of the rule silently depends on per-site SQL that is easy to get wrong, as here.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through shouldWriteMonthBudget; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category queries in set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg are verbatim, not disguised.

one_place.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden/group-hidden/template rule for all month-wide actions; caveat: the average actions' queries do not select group_hidden, so that input is not supplied consistently.
